name: @matatbread/matbot-background-jobs
description: Run prompts as background jobs — now, at a time, or on an interval — that report into a conversation by appending to it, and stay silent when there is nothing to say. Jobs run in this process; @matatbread/matbot-background-jobs-node runs each in its own. Supersedes @matatbread/matbot-tool-background.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "process.env.MATBOT_PUBLISH_ALL || (console.error('Refused: publish with pnpm publish-all from the repo root. It checks versions, contents and the web bundle first.'), process.exit(1))"
